title: Selling Courses Without Teachable or Stripe: An Honest Side-by-Side Breakdown That Actually Works
author: COREMERCH
excerpt: Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy block creators in dozens of countries. Here is the sovereign infrastructure that works everywhere they do not.

content.text: You're a digital creator in Nigeria, and you've hit a roadblock. You've built your online course library, but Teachable and Stripe have blocked your account due to "restricted country" policies. You're left scrambling to find a new payment solution, but every alternative seems to come with its own set of problems. You need a permanent, reliable way to sell your courses without getting locked out again. The question is: what architecture can you trust?
What Each Option Actually Offers

When you try to sell courses without Teachable or Stripe, you're often left with a hodgepodge of platforms like Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, or Paddle. But these alternatives come with their own set of limitations. Gumroad, for example, charges a 3.5% + 30¢ per sale fee, and its user interface is clunky at best. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle offer more flexibility, but their pricing plans are complex and difficult to navigate. Meanwhile, now you have to deal with foreign currency exchange fees, which can eat into your profit margins. You need a solution that's more robust, more flexible, and more cost-effective.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

When it comes to restricted countries, the major payment processors like Stripe and PayPal have a clear policy: they won't do business with certain countries due to 'regulatory reasons'. But what this really means is that they're avoiding countries with high-risk currencies or unstable economies. As a result, digital creators in these countries are left without access to reliable payment solutions. But there's a permanent structural alternative: sovereign commerce infrastructure. With this architecture, you're not dependent on any single platform or payment processor. You own your own commerce stack, and you can operate independently of any restrictions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When you use traditional payment processors, you're often hit with a range of fees that add up quickly. Transaction fees, currency conversion fees, and even withdrawal fees can eat into your profit margins. But with sovereign commerce infrastructure, the fees are lower, and the costs are more transparent. For example, NOWPayments charges a flat 0.5% fee per transaction, with no hidden costs or surprise fees. This means you can keep more of your hard-earned money and focus on growing your business.
